segments.text:
V. 34.
And when he had called the people—To hear a Truth of the laſt Importance, and one that equally concerned them all. Let him deny himſelf—His own Will, in all Things, ſmall and great, however pleaſing, and that continually: And take up his croſs—Embrace the Will of GOD, however painful, daily, hourly, continually. Thus only can he follow me in Holineſs, to Glory.
